setupNotes: The first fixture insert attempted all 50,000 rows in one statement and hit the existing 10-second statement timeout before any retrieval was measured. Fixture setup now uses batches of 500; application timeouts are unchanged.
limitations: One synthetic scout, eight manually seeded source-review records and 50,000 synthetic postings in a warm disposable local database. Both modes use the current repository; keyword_only has no admitted discovery IDs. This checks the retrieval handoff, not production capacity, large discovery-history joins, independent relevance, provider work or full pipeline latency.
